format: html

---


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```
```{r}

ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    name = "Median household income",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Texas",
    subtitle = "2020 American Community Survey",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

```
